requirement: Reuse an existing React-to-WeChat toolchain rather than implement a renderer or compiler

investigation.finding: QuickStart and existing isolated probes are native; no existing Taro compiler or product engineering found
CloudBase SDK covers backend services, not React rendering; Taro official default template and compiler support the WeChat build target
Use the user-approved Taro adapter; do not add an unrelated admin system or renderer. Official template covers the minimum build experiment, so no broad template search is needed
Only prepare isolated paths and inspect generated artifacts; do not reimplement compilation, platform components or lifecycle runtime

adoption: Adapt official React/TypeScript template for an isolated WeChat-only build; do not freeze product versions
adaptation: Remove unused platforms, CSS preprocessors, generator and Git hooks
Keep official compiler, React renderer and components
Use touristappid and a synthetic page without cloud calls

comparison.directTemplate: Lowest initial generation effort, but includes unnecessary platform/tooling options and does not establish compatibility or security
comparison.localAdaptation: Selected for experiment; small config/source changes, independent removal and official runtime updates; still must resolve type and dependency issues
comparison.ownRenderer: Rejected: highest compiler, runtime, platform API and upgrade/regression burden with no demonstrated need
